A personal takeaway, in my own words:

blockquote.p: Familiarity can feel like understanding. Before an important decision, make room to question the first answer that comes to mind.

ul.li: System 1: quick, intuitive judgments that require little effort.
System 2: slower, more deliberate reasoning that requires attention.
Practice: pause before deciding when the stakes are high.
